Container.Name: spawnpoint
Container.Overview: SpawnPoint: a self-hosted, MintServers-style Minecraft host. One-click modpacks (Modrinth, CurseForge, FTB), single-mod installs, a built-in router so every server gets its own address on port 25565 (atm10.mc.example.com), wake-on-join, automatic RAM/CPU tuning and background world pre-generation. Each Minecraft server runs in SpawnPoint's own private Docker engine, so only this one container appears in your Docker tab. Privileged is required for that.
Container.Requires: Image is private on GHCR: Unraid needs docker login ghcr.io (a classic token with read:packages).

Config.Name: Minecraft port
Config.Description: All Minecraft players come in here. Point Pangolin's raw TCP resource at UnraidIP:this port.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Panel. Put a Pangolin HTTPS resource with auth in front of it if you want it outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Server data (NVMe)
Config.Description: Worlds, mods and configs. Use the /mnt/cache/... path (your NVMe cache), not /mnt/user/..., and never the array.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Backup archives. The array is fine here.

Config.Name: Engine storage (NVMe pool path)
Config.Description: SpawnPoint's private Docker engine (game images and containers). Must be a /mnt/cache/... path, NOT /mnt/user/...

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the web UI.

Config.Name: Base domain
Config.Description: Servers get NAME.this-domain. Needs a wildcard DNS record such as *.mc pointing at this machine (or your VPS).

Config.Name: CurseForge API key
Config.Description: Optional. Free key from console.curseforge.com; enables CurseForge modpacks.

Config.Name: Minecraft RAM pool (GB)
Config.Description: Total RAM all Minecraft servers may use together. Leave blank to use three quarters of this machine's RAM (at most 96 GB).

Config.Name: Reserved core groups
Config.Description: Core groups kept for Unraid and other apps. A group is 2 cores with their threads (one L3 slice on a 7F72). Never more than a third of the CPU is held back.

Config.Name: Burst core groups
Config.Description: Extra core groups lent to a server while it pre-generates its world.

Config.Name: Max servers borrowing cores
Config.Description: How many servers can pre-generate on borrowed cores at once.

Config.Name: Spawn pre-gen radius
Config.Description: Blocks generated before a new server opens.

Config.Name: Full pre-gen radius
Config.Description: Blocks generated in the background after opening.

Config.Name: Pause pre-gen above (ms/tick)
Config.Description: Background pre-generation pauses when tick time goes above this.

Config.Name: Resume pre-gen below (ms/tick)
Config.Description: ...and resumes when it drops below this.

Config.Name: World maps
Config.Description: Draw a top-down map of every server's world, on spare CPU cores. false = only the generation view.

Config.Name: Map update interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often a changed world is redrawn at most. Only changed chunks are redrawn.

Config.Name: Maps drawn at once
Config.Description: How many servers' maps can be drawn at the same time. Each one borrows 2 spare core groups while it runs.

Config.Name: Docker network
Config.Description: Private network SpawnPoint creates for its server containers. Leave as is.

Config.Name: Hide servers from Docker tab
Config.Description: true = private engine inside SpawnPoint (needs Privileged). false = use Unraid's Docker (map /var/run/docker.sock, add --pid=host --cap-add=SYS_NICE); servers then show as mc-* containers.

Config.Name: Wake on join
Config.Description: A player joining a stopped or sleeping server starts it.
